meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提出时间序列机器学习任务时，Claude会使用 aeon 工具包（一个 Python 库）来处理，支持分类、回归、预测等任务，并给出可运行的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当用户请求处理时间序列数据、时序模式或时间索引观测，例如要求进行预测、异常检测或分类等任务时触发。

say.text: 用 aeon 对这份销量时间序列做 5 步预测
say.note: Claude会使用aeon预测器生成代码和预测结果

say.text: 用 aeon 的 ROCKET 分类这个时间序列数据集
say.note: Claude会运行分类器并输出准确率

say.text: 用 aeon 的 STOMP 检测这组温度数据中的异常
say.note: Claude会计算异常分数并标记异常点

howto.what_en: Once installed, when the user asks for time series machine learning, Claude will use the aeon toolkit (a Python library) to handle tasks such as classification, regression, forecasting, and produce runnable Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests processing temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations, for example asking for forecasting, anomaly detection, or classification.

say_en.text: Forecast the next 5 steps of this sales time series with aeon
say_en.note: Claude will use the aeon forecaster to generate code and predictions

say_en.text: Classify this time series dataset with aeon's ROCKET
say_en.note: Claude will run the classifier and output accuracy

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this temperature data with aeon's STOMP
say_en.note: Claude will compute anomaly scores and flag outliers
